subject: You Are Right: Regrets Again....
author: ichienkai
body:
It was a great bunch of people that no longer play together Boot.... All because of a stupid misunderstanding and i take back what i said last night.  I dont hate Mr Frogerson despite his deathly threats to me over xbox live.  I miss him in a strange way, he was/is a damn good racer and i miss Mr McT too (even if he is a constant GOW player)!

I didnt realise you and McT had played together that long man and i hate to think that anything that happened that i was involved with at the time broke something - like you said we all have different personalitys and Mr McT's is certainly unique if nothing else. 

I dunno maybe Frogerson will turn up on a FBI gamertag on Halo 3 and t-bag me and all will be forgotton - hope to see Pete on there anyway: Halo 3 comes out and your racin days are over Boot yeah??? Until Paradise comes and you think damn what have they done to Burnout hahaha just kiddin...!

 

Women and cats will do as they please, and men and dogs should relax and get used to the idea.

subject: That episode that happened
author: BootlegGiant
body:
That episode that happened months ago broke up a great team, did you know up to that point I had played on live with Pete for nearly 2 maybe 3 years and then you and Mr Frogerson go into hardcore mode and I quit the game in disgust (don't need that crap) I dont think I have played with Mr McTavish since, he went over to Gears I stayed on Revenge and Mr Frogerson played PC games, I still keep in touch with the dudes and Pete sends me the odd message about how much I suck (coming from a guy who owns a 2 seat er sports car) however I do believe that that Pete will teabag me on Halo 3 (that is so degrading),

We all have different personality's ichi, if we were all the same it would be boring, I don't  think that there is anybody on xbox live or this great site that I hate, its true I don't get on with a few people, we are not perfect, we are humans, we all have our flaws, I might have a couple more than most, I don't know.. (yes I am still Vain)

As for your cheep Internet connection dude, you should play more ranked games dude get those magic numbers higher than mine then I can really call you a noob

And finally, it was another great night on revenge, Darren was a blast (very funny dude), however I do think his ego is bigger than mine, (hard to believe I know) and I had to choose my words carefully, I don't want Foxy deleting me as then I wouldn't be able to rip into you, Darren should get a 360 do it Darren, Urm oh yes SUFFUR joined the room, there was a slight awkward moment that lasted a nano second and then he did what everyone else does and timed me out and called me a noob (ok I made that bit up) we had Zombie in the room and I got two takedowns on her (sweet) one was that I spawned on top of her and got Verticalllll but did not call it so technically dosent count dang it, I think The Creator was playing and Zom was talking as that is the only way I can explain getting owned by a chick, this should have been a Blogg and 3 points but heck I'm still second place so I can rest a while, We had a bit of trouble getting on the EA servers last night, Ok thats it I think.. byeeeee

 

----Boo Hoo SUFFUR hates me Boo Hoo----

subject: Yes a good room
author: SUFFUR
body:
I had fun, yes, a small nano sec of silence, but fun all the same and racing 190's again was fun, prefer, 205's, but since i rarely host, it doesn't happen often.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when its going to run out?
